#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title 'Annual Financial Report' and today's date."""
import datetime
import os
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

WORKDIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
REPORT = os.path.join(WORKDIR, "report.pdf")
COVER = os.path.join(WORKDIR, "cover_page.pdf")
OUTPUT = os.path.join(WORKDIR, "report_with_cover.pdf")
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def main() -> int:
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
        print(f"ERROR: {REPORT} not found", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    reader = PdfReader(REPORT)
    if len(reader.pages) == 0:
        print("ERROR: report.pdf contains no pages", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    # Match the cover page size to the report's first page.
    mediabox = reader.pages[0].mediabox
    width = float(mediabox.width)
    height = float(mediabox.height)

    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    # Build the cover page.
    c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=(width, height))
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height * 0.58, TITLE)
    c.setLineWidth(1.5)
    c.line(width * 0.2, height * 0.55, width * 0.8, height * 0.55)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height * 0.50, date_str)
    c.save()

    # Prepend the cover page to the report.
    writer = PdfWriter()
    cover = PdfReader(COVER)
    writer.add_page(cover.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    # Put the result back into report.pdf so the file itself has the cover.
    os.replace(OUTPUT, REPORT)
    os.remove(COVER)

    final = PdfReader(REPORT)
    first_text = (final.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip().replace("\n", " | ")
    print(f"OK: cover page added to {REPORT}")
    print(f"Title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"Date: {date_str}")
    print(f"Pages: {len(reader.pages)} -> {len(final.pages)}")
    print(f"Cover text: {first_text}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Probe which PDF-relevant Python modules are importable in this environment."""
import importlib
import sys

MODULES = [
    "pypdf",
    "reportlab",
    "fpdf",
    "fitz",          # PyMuPDF
    "pypdfium2",
    "weasyprint",
    "PIL",
    "pdfplumber",
]

for name in MODULES:
    try:
        mod = importlib.import_module(name)
        version = getattr(mod, "__version__", "unknown")
        print(f"{name}: AVAILABLE (version={version})")
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"{name}: missing ({type(exc).__name__}: {exc})")

print(f"python: {sys.version}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title 'Annual Financial Report' and today's date.

Uses only pypdf + stdlib: the cover page is emitted as a minimal raw-PDF one-pager
with the built-in Helvetica fonts, then prepended to the report via pypdf.
"""
import datetime
import os
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

WORKDIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
REPORT = os.path.join(WORKDIR, "report.pdf")
COVER = os.path.join(WORKDIR, "cover_page.pdf")
OUTPUT = os.path.join(WORKDIR, "report_with_cover.pdf")
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def build_cover_pdf(path, width, height, title, date_str):
    """Write a minimal one-page PDF (built-in Helvetica) to `path`."""
    # Approximate string widths for centering (per-char avg factors).
    title_w = 32 * 0.60 * len(title)
    date_w = 16 * 0.50 * len(date_str)

    ty = height * 0.58
    ly = height * 0.545
    dy = height * 0.50

    stream = (
        "q\n"
        f"0.86 0.90 0.96 rg\n"
        f"0 0 {width:.2f} {height:.2f} re f\n"
        "Q\n"
        "BT\n"
        "/F1 32 Tf\n"
        "0.13 0.22 0.36 rg\n"
        f"1 0 0 1 {(width - title_w) / 2:.2f} {ty:.2f} Tm\n"
        f"({title}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
        "0.20 0.45 0.80 RG\n"
        "2 w\n"
        f"{width * 0.20:.2f} {ly:.2f} m\n"
        f"{width * 0.80:.2f} {ly:.2f} l\n"
        "S\n"
        "BT\n"
        "/F2 16 Tf\n"
        "0.25 0.30 0.45 rg\n"
        f"1 0 0 1 {(width - date_w) / 2:.2f} {dy:.2f} Tm\n"
        f"({date_str}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        (
            f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {width:.2f} {height:.2f}] "
            f"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>"
        ).encode("latin-1"),
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        b"<< /Length " + str(len(stream)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n" + stream + b"\nendstream",
    ]

    header = b"%PDF-1.4\n"
    body = bytearray()
    offsets = []
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(header) + len(body))
        body += f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode("latin-1") + obj + b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_offset = len(header) + len(body)
    xref = bytearray(f"xref\n0 {len(objects) + 1}\n".encode("latin-1"))
    xref += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        xref += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("latin-1")
    trailer = (
        f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objects) + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
        f"startxref\n{xref_offset}\n%%EOF\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")

    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(header + body + xref + trailer)


def main() -> int:
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
        print(f"ERROR: {REPORT} not found", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    reader = PdfReader(REPORT)
    if len(reader.pages) == 0:
        print("ERROR: report.pdf contains no pages", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    # Match the cover page size to the report's first page.
    mediabox = reader.pages[0].mediabox
    width = float(mediabox.width)
    height = float(mediabox.height)

    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    build_cover_pdf(COVER, width, height, TITLE, date_str)

    # Prepend the cover page to the report.
    writer = PdfWriter()
    cover = PdfReader(COVER)
    writer.add_page(cover.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)

    # Put the result back into report.pdf so the file itself has the cover.
    os.replace(OUTPUT, REPORT)
    os.remove(COVER)

    final = PdfReader(REPORT)
    first_text = (final.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip().replace("\n", " | ")
    print(f"OK: cover page added to {REPORT}")
    print(f"Title: {TITLE}")
    print(f"Date: {date_str}")
    print(f"Pages: {len(reader.pages)} -> {len(final.pages)}")
    print(f"Cover text: {first_text}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
